name: Idaho

rates2026.note: state rate set at $7.25 and tracks the federal minimum wage

tipped.note: employer must make up the difference if tips plus cash wage fall below $7.25

minWage.other: Employees under 20: $4.25 per hour during the first 90 consecutive calendar days of employment

source.quote: no employer shall pay to any of his employees any wages computed at a rate of less than seven dollars and twenty-five cents ($7.25) per hour

overtime.note: No state overtime law; federal FLSA overtime (over 40 hours a week) applies to covered employers.

sickLeave.note: No statewide paid sick leave requirement for private employers.

finalPay.fired: by the earlier of the next regularly scheduled payday or 10 days (weekends and holidays excluded); within 48 hours of a written request
finalPay.quit: by the earlier of the next regularly scheduled payday or 10 days (weekends and holidays excluded); within 48 hours of a written request
finalPay.ptoNote: no Idaho statute requires payout of accrued vacation; follows employer policy or agreement

source.quote: all wages then due the employee by the earlier of the next regularly scheduled payday or within ten (10) days of such layoff or termination, weekends and holidays excluded.
Idaho is not listed in the U.S. DOL table of state meal period requirements (cross-check)

rightToWorkSource.quote: No person shall be required, as a condition of employment or continuation of employment, ... (2) to become or remain a member of a labor organization

notes.text: Cities and counties in Idaho may not set a minimum wage higher than the state rate.

source.quote: No political subdivision of this state ... shall establish by ordinance or other action minimum wages higher than the minimum wages provided in this section.

notes.text: A departing employee can get final wages within 48 hours (weekends and holidays excluded) by making a written request to the employer.

source.quote: if the employee makes written request upon the employer for earlier payment of wages, all wages then due the employee shall be paid within forty-eight (48) hours

notes.text: Employers may pay workers under 20 a training wage of $4.25 an hour for their first 90 days, but may not displace other employees to do so.

source.quote: an employee who has not attained twenty (20) years of age a wage which is not less than four dollars and twenty-five cents ($4.25) an hour during the first ninety (90) consecutive calendar days
